counting_method: Upper-bound count of Packet 12 rule records in affected standard families. A source may satisfy only one of several required inputs, so affected does not mean independently sufficient.

priorities.source: Authoritative Coastal boundary plus a completed current Coastal RS standards profile
would_unlock: inside-Coastal applicability selection across the RS domain
priorities.reason: Largest rule reach, but context-limited: it does not change the already supported outside-Coastal profile and does not supply parcel measurements.

priorities.source: Project-specific proposed use, unit count, structure, paving, garage, and refuse-storage plans
would_unlock: project/program inputs for density, structures, setbacks, hardscape, refuse storage, dwelling protection, and supplemental requirements
priorities.reason: Broadest non-applicability input reach, though these are proposal facts rather than stable parcel-base facts.

priorities.source: Authoritative survey, recorded map, and legal lot/subdivision records
priorities.reason: These foundational legal/cadastral semantics block the core dimensional standards and cannot be recovered from polygon shape.

priorities.source: Authoritative building footprints, structure elevations/heights, story data, and gross floor area
priorities.reason: Parcel V2 contains no structure geometry or Code-appropriate floor-area measurement.

priorities.source: Authoritative topography/slope and Fire Code defensible-space determinations
priorities.reason: Parcel outline has no elevation or Fire Code determination.

priorities.source: Official street and right-of-way geometry plus legally defined parcel-frontage relationships
priorities.reason: Road adjacency alone would remain diagnostic until tied to the Code-defined lot-line relationship.

priorities.source: Authoritative correction for missing Table 131-04D footnote 8
priorities.reason: The current official table prints the marker without the footnote text.
